text: Entry Requirements Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport and senior high school diploma or above, above the age of 18 and under the age of 25, in good health; Language Proficiency Requirement: English Taught Programs: IELTS≧5.5 or TOEFL≧70 or pass the exam by CQUPT China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA): Provide transcript of China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA). Please refer to the attachment, CSCA Subjects for 2026-2027 Undergraduate Program in CQUPT , for the exam subjects and test paper languages corresponding to each major.
